description: This file implements functions and data structures related to ISO 639 language codes, including a lookup table and methods for finding language entries by code or ID within the WPEFramework::Core namespace.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: A class providing methods to look up language codes based on ISO 639 standards.

methods.name: FindLanguage
methods.description: Finds a language entry based on a language code string, setting internal indices accordingly.

methods.name: FindLanguage
methods.description: Finds a language entry based on a numeric ID, setting internal indices accordingly.
